We're having a great time so far at Cloud Native Denmark. Today Gabriele Bartolini led a workshop introducing participants to CloudNativePG using "cnpg-playground", our open local learning environment. We covered controlled switchover, continuous backup, point-in-time recovery, and more: https://www.gabrielebartolini.it/slides/2026-11-19-cloud-native-denmark-cnpg-workshop/ #PostgreSQL #Kubernetes
